body.input: Which companies hired a country manager for Sweden in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, the following companies appointed a Country Manager for Sweden in 2026:

1. **Amazon** — Appointed **Julian Tydeman** as Country Manager for Sweden (announced 9 November 2026). Tydeman has been with Amazon since 2009 and was part of the team that launched Amazon.se in 2020.

2. **Nordnet** — Appointed **Britta Rosenqvist** as Country Manager Sweden, effective 1 December 2026 (announced 8 October 2026). She brings experience from senior management roles in the Swedish banking and financial sector.

3. **Enerim** — Appointed **Håkan Danström** as Country Manager for Sweden, effective 2 March 2026. He brings experience from the utility SaaS sector, having held senior roles at EG A/S and Tieto.

4. **Lindex** — Appointed **Malin Lundell** as Country Manager for Sweden, effective 9 March 2026, to strengthen the brand's market leadership in its home market.

5. **Visual Art** — Appointed **Emily Lindqvist** as Country Manager for Sweden. She had worked at the company for nine years and most recently led the Design Studio.

6. **Snowflake** — Appointed **Per Enell** as Head of Sweden (Country Manager) to drive the growth strategy and strengthen Snowflake's position in the Swedish market.

These are the appointments identified from publicly available sources during 2026. There may be additional appointments not captured here.

Julian Tydeman has been with Amazon since 2009, working in the United Kingdom, Luxembourg and Sweden. Most recently, he led Customer Experience and Onsite Marketing for Amazon’s Emerging Stores in Europe. Before joining Amazon, he served for five years in the British Army as a captain in the Royal Signals, and he holds an MBA from the Kellogg School of Management at Northwestern University.

# Per Enell Appointed Sweden Country Manager for Snowflake

Snowflake, the leading AI Data Cloud company, has appointed Per Enell as the new Head of Sweden. In this role he will drive the growth strategy and further strengthen Snowflake’s position in the Swedish market.

### Focus on data-driven innovation and business efficiency [...] With a customer base that includes many of Sweden’s most innovative companies, Per Enell will help organizations maximise the value of their data and AI solutions to streamline business processes. His responsibilities include breaking down data silos, simplifying secure data sharing and enabling data-driven innovation through AI, machine learning (ML) and generative AI.

### From Norway to Sweden — a strategic move [...] Snowflake continues to grow rapidly in Sweden and plans to hire additional specialists to meet customer demand.

“Our success depends on recruiting the right talent and developing the organisation. We are also investing in our partnerships to deliver maximum value to customers,” concludes Per Enell.

With Per Enell at the helm, Snowflake’s future in Sweden looks promising as AI, cloud-based data management and digital transformation remain central priorities.
